recentItems.title: Maury eyes bounce-back in meeting of state champions
recentItems.description: The Maury Commodores opened the 2026 season with a 31-30 loss to Mallard Creek, but the program's second defeat since the start of 2023 has not rattled a team that has made a habit of bouncing back.  Head coach Dyrri McCain said the message is simple.  "Reality is we're 0-1 and we've just got to figure out ways to get in the win column and continue to make a run that we're trying to make," McCain said. "No panic here."  Sophomore defensive back and wide receiver Tajuan Pair echoed that mindset.  "The message is just get back to practice, have a good mindset and just take a step back to see what we did wrong and get back on track," Pair noted.
